# Des Moines Wellness Center

> Accredited addiction and mental health treatment center in Johnston, Iowa, serving Des Moines and Central Iowa with medical detox, residential rehab, outpatient programs and dual diagnosis care.

Address: 5820 Winwood Dr, Johnston, IA 50131. Admissions (24/7): 888-378-2158. Email: info@desmoinesrecovery.com. Insurance can be verified free and confidentially at https://www.desmoinesrecovery.com/verify-insurance/.

## Therapies

- [Addiction & Mental Health Therapies](https://www.desmoinesrecovery.com/therapies/): Explore our evidence-based therapies for addiction in Des Moines, including CBT, DBT, trauma-informed care, family therapy, and dual diagnosis treatment.
- [CBT for Addiction, Des Moines IA](https://www.desmoinesrecovery.com/therapies/cognitive-behavioral-therapy/): Cognitive Behavioral Therapy at our Johnston, IA facility. CBT identifies the thoughts and triggers behind substance use and builds practical coping skills.
- [DBT for Addiction, Des Moines IA](https://www.desmoinesrecovery.com/therapies/dialectical-behavior-therapy/): Dialectical Behavior Therapy at our Johnston, IA facility. DBT builds distress tolerance and emotional regulation for dual-diagnosis care.
- [Family Therapy, Des Moines IA](https://www.desmoinesrecovery.com/therapies/family-therapy/): Family sessions at our Johnston, IA facility. We repair communication and educate your support system so the environment you return to supports recovery.
- [Group Therapy, Des Moines IA](https://www.desmoinesrecovery.com/therapies/group-therapy/): Facilitated group sessions at our Johnston, IA facility. Peer-supported recovery that reduces isolation and builds accountability alongside individual care.
- [Individual Therapy, Des Moines IA](https://www.desmoinesrecovery.com/therapies/individual-therapy/): One-to-one counseling at our Johnston, IA facility. Private sessions with licensed clinicians to build a personal recovery and relapse-prevention plan.
- [Trauma-Informed Care, Des Moines IA](https://www.desmoinesrecovery.com/therapies/trauma-informed-care/): Trauma-informed addiction treatment at our Johnston, IA facility. Specialized protocols that process past experiences without causing re-traumatization.
